_RetentionNotes: Bounds run-history / journal growth. RunHistoryDays: terminal runs (Completed/Failed/Cancelled/Discarded) older than this are deleted along with their journal entries and node states; in-flight runs and anything newer are kept. Set to 0 (or negative) to disable pruning and keep everything forever. SweepIntervalMinutes: how often the background sweep runs (first sweep one interval after startup).
_StorageNotes: DataDirectory is the machine-wide home for the SQLite DB and the auto-generated at-rest credential key in a productive build. Empty = default %ProgramData%\Knotarium (Windows) / CommonApplicationData/Knotarium (other OS). Set an absolute path (or Storage__DataDirectory env) to share one DB + key across a Windows service and an interactive run, or to point at a mounted volume in Docker. Ignored in Development (relative project paths).
_AiNotes: The AI provider (vendor, model, and API-key credential) is configured in the UI: Settings → AI Provider, persisted as the 'AiProviderConfig' AppSetting. Supported vendors: anthropic, openai, azure, gemini. Provider calls go through the egress policy — allowed by default (empty Security.HttpEgress.AllowDomains). If you switch to an explicit allowlist, add the provider host(s) (e.g. api.anthropic.com, api.openai.com, *.openai.azure.com, generativelanguage.googleapis.com).
